native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 1, 'state': {'servo1': 0, 'servo2': 0, 'rgb1': 'off'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After power-on or reset, both servos are at 0 degrees and the RGB LED is off.'}

test2: {'time': 3, 'state': {'servo1': 90, 'servo2': 0, 'rgb1': 'red'}, 'description': 'Button 1 pressed. Servo1 rotates to 90 degrees, Servo2 remains at 0 degrees, and the RGB LED turns red. This state is maintained for at least 2 seconds.'}

test3: {'time': 5, 'state': {'servo1': 0, 'servo2': 0, 'rgb1': 'green'}, 'description': 'Button 2 pressed while Button 1 is already pressed. Both servos return to 0 degrees, and the RGB LED turns green. This state is maintained for at least 2 seconds.'}

test4: {'time': 7, 'state': {'servo1': 0, 'servo2': 180, 'rgb1': 'blue'}, 'description': 'Button 2 pressed (after previous state reset). Servo2 rotates to 180 degrees, Servo1 remains at 0 degrees, and the RGB LED turns blue. This state is maintained for at least 2 seconds.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
